news.headline: Chargers relieved after beating Ravens for first win of season
news.description: The Chargers beat the Ravens 23-30 on Monday night to earn their first win since Week 16 of last season, bringing a franchise-wide sigh of relief.

news.headline: Justin Herbert, defense help lift Chargers past Ravens on MNF
news.description: The Chargers' defense stifles Baltimore's running backs, and Justin Herbert steps up in Los Angeles' first win.

news.headline: Rams center Coleman Shelton out 4-6 weeks with hamstring injury
news.description: Coleman Shelton strained his hamstring in the second quarter of the Rams' Week 10 victory over the Cardinals.

news.headline: Mike McCarthy on Steelers' blowout loss: 'Needs to stop there'
news.description: After a deflating loss at Cincinnati, Pittsburgh faces a Week 11 gut-check game at the Eagles on Sunday.

news.headline: Sources: Jets QB Geno Smith avoided major ankle injury, testing shows
news.description: Imaging tests performed on Jets quarterback Geno Smith's injured left ankle did not reveal any major concerns, sources said Monday.

news.headline: Kyle Hamilton rocks Christmas sweater ahead of 'MNF,' leads NFL Week 10 arrivals
news.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

news.headline: Behind Raiders fans' tribute to Fernando Mendoza's mother
news.description: Tom Joanides' social media campaign became a meaningful tribute when Mendoza scored in his first NFL start.

news.headline: Bears RB Kyle Monangai says he's 'on track' to return Sunday against Saints
news.description: Bears running back Kyle Monangai said Monday that he's "on track" to return Sunday against the Saints after sitting out five games because of a thumb injury and turf toe.

news.headline: 49ers WR Mike Evans' Achilles tendinitis injury explained
news.description: ESPN spoke with a medical professional for a better understanding of Evans' diagnosis. When could he return? And will the injury completely resolve itself?

news.headline: Seahawks' Mike Macdonald 'optimistic' QB Sam Darnold returns after bye week
news.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald is "optimistic" QB Sam Darnold will return to his starting role after the team's bye week.

transactions.text: Signed LB Joe Bachie from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Seth McLaughlin and RB Jabari Small to the practice squad. Placed G Mason Miller on the practice squad/injured list.

Signed OLs Devin Cochran and Mason Miller, WRs Malik Cunningham and Jackson Meeks, DE Ahmed Hassanein, TE Zach Horton, RB Jabari Small, DL Chris Smith and S Loren Strickland to reserve/futures contracts. Re-signed OL Michael Niese, RB Jacob Saylors and CB Nick Whiteside.

insights: 2026 cap number of $248K is the 68th-largest on the roster.
Entered the league in 2025 as an undrafted free agent.
